COURT’S OR JUDGES’S ORDERS
WPSS No.1327 of 2024
Hon’ble Pankaj Purohit, J.
1. Mr. Bhagwat Mehra, learned counsel for 
the petitioners.
2. Mr. Rajeev Singh Bisht, learned Addl. 
C.S.C. for the State of Uttarakhand.
3. Mr. Ashish Joshi, learned Standing 
Counsel for respondent no.3-Commission. 
4. Mr. S.S. Chauhan, learned counsel for 
respondent no.4. 
5. Heard learned counsel for the parties.
6. It is contended by learned counsel for the 
petitioners that in the similar set of 
controversy, this Court has passed interim 
order on 13.06.2024 in WPSS No.316 of 2024. 
Since, the controversy involved in the present 
writ petition is identical, interim order can be 
passed in this petition. 
7. Learned State Counsel as well as learned 
counsel for respondent no.3 has not disputed 
the said submission made by the learned 
counsel for the petitioners. However learned
counsel for the respondent no.03 apprised the 
court that result of the selection is declared on 
10.07.2024. 
8. List this case on 04.12.2024. 
9. Till next date of listing, the respondents 
are restrained from interfering in functioning of 
the petitioners to the post of Junior Engineer. 
10. In the meantime, respondents may file 
counter affidavit, if any. 
11. Interim relief application (IA/1/2024) 
stands disposed of accordingly.
 
 (Pankaj Purohit, J.) 
 24.07.2024
Arti
